articles.summary: Finland-based energy management solution Synergi wants to make it easy for consumers to save on their energy bills and positively contribute to the energy transition by using electricity flexibly. To maximize impact, they wanted to offer a range of consumption management services supporting all types of residential energy devices. Here's how partnering with Enode enabled them to do that without tying up too much time or development resources.
articles.title: How Synergi is accelerating product development and empowering more energy consumers using Enode
